### Description

I am running Uvicorn with --reload mode and it is randomly and very frequently getting stuck on below line.

Uvicorn Reload Getting Stuck : WARNING StarReload detected Changes in file.py. Reloading....

I need to kill using CRTL+C and start again at new PORT and it is randomly getting stuck when changes are made to any PY file

Any suggestion for overcome this issue :)

answer.body:
Hello @HarsimranjitSingh, 
if you are on windows and you are on pycharm this is a known bug from pycharm.
You can read more on it
https://github.com/encode/uvicorn/issues/2000
https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/PY-60962/os.killpid-signal.CRTLCEVENT-ignored-when-running-python-program-from-Pycharm

try to start your app without pycharm.
